result:
The ratio is most likely 1, which matches Solution 1's final answer. This rests on my recollection of Hattori's results on finite-slope Drinfeld cuspforms, not on a derivation.

As I recall it, the finite-slope part of the space does not grow as the ℘-power in the level increases beyond 1, as in Hida-style stability. A finite-slope eigensystem appearing at level Γ₁(𝔫℘) therefore keeps the same multiplicity at level Γ₁(𝔫℘^r).

Solution 1 reaches this answer, though its argument is loose. Solution 2's linear growth by r is not supported by anything I recall. Solution 3 openly guesses its exponent and its coset-counting heuristic has no basis. Both give a ratio other than 1.

VERDICT 1: ACCEPT
VERDICT 2: REJECT
VERDICT 3: REJECT
